name: Alphabet Inc.
tagline: Organizing the world's information and making it universally accessible
hero_kpi_rationale: Google Cloud est le principal vecteur de croissance structurelle et d'adoption de l'IA générative via ses offres d'infrastructure et Vertex AI, positionné comme driver stratégique face à AWS et Azure.

kpis.signal: Joyau Alphabet, ~57% du CA Google Services, croissance soutenue malgre AI Overviews
kpis.description_fr: CA Google Search + autres requetes (Lens, Shopping, Maps, Play). Pilier historique Alphabet, integration AI Overviews. ~57% du CA Google Services FY24.
kpis.description_en: Google Search + other queries revenue (Lens, Shopping, Maps, Play). Alphabet historical pillar, AI Overviews integrated. ~57% of Google Services revenue FY24.

kpis.signal: Hypercroissance soutenue, segment transformateur Alphabet, profitable depuis 2023
kpis.description_fr: GCP (infrastructure) + Workspace (productivite). Croissance >30%/an portee par GenAI (Gemini, Vertex AI). Segment qui change la trajectoire Alphabet, profitable depuis Q1 2023.
kpis.description_en: GCP (infrastructure) + Workspace (productivity). >30% growth driven by GenAI (Gemini, Vertex AI). Transformative segment, profitable since Q1 2023.

kpis.signal: Re-acceleration via Shorts et CTV (Connected TV), monetisation en hausse
kpis.description_fr: Revenus publicitaires YouTube (hors Premium/Music). Shorts monetise + traction CTV (#1 streaming aux US par watch-time). Hors abonnements.
kpis.description_en: YouTube ad revenue (ex-Premium/Music). Shorts monetization + CTV traction (#1 US streaming watch-time). Ad-only.

kpis.signal: Marge operationnelle Services ~40%, cash machine qui finance Cloud + Bets + buybacks
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel segment Google Services (ads + subs + devices). Marge ~40% FY24. Cash machine qui finance Cloud, Other Bets et rachats actions.
kpis.description_en: Operating income for Google Services segment (ads + subs + devices). ~40% margin FY24. Cash machine funding Cloud, Other Bets and buybacks.

kpis.signal: Diversification non-ad (YouTube Premium/TV, Google One, Pixel) en hausse continue
kpis.description_fr: YouTube Premium/Music/TV/NFL Sunday Ticket + Google One + Pixel + Play Store. Pivot vers revenus recurrents hors publicite.
kpis.description_en: YouTube Premium/Music/TV/NFL Sunday Ticket + Google One + Pixel + Play Store. Pivot to non-ad recurring revenue.

kpis.signal: Bascule profitable confirmee (marge ~14% FY24), preuve modele economique Cloud
kpis.description_fr: Resultat operationnel Google Cloud. Passage de -5.6 Mds$ (2020) a +6.1 Mds$ (2024). Marge ~14% FY24, valide le scale economique du segment.
kpis.description_en: Google Cloud operating income. From -$5.6B (2020) to +$6.1B (2024). ~14% margin FY24, validates segment unit economics.

kpis.signal: Couts payes a Apple/Samsung/partenaires distribution, croissance < revenus ads
kpis.description_fr: Couts d'acquisition de trafic (paiements a Apple Safari, Samsung, partenaires Network). KPI structurel : croissance < revenus ads = levier de marge.
kpis.description_en: Traffic Acquisition Costs (payments to Apple Safari, Samsung, Network partners). Structural KPI: growth < ad revenue growth = margin lever.

kpis.signal: Deceleration continue (AdSense/AdMob/Ad Manager), pression cookieless + concurrence retail media
kpis.description_fr: AdSense, AdMob, Ad Manager (publicite tierce). Segment en decrue depuis 2022, pression cookieless + retail media networks.
kpis.description_en: AdSense, AdMob, Ad Manager (third-party ads). Declining since 2022, cookieless pressure + retail media competition.

kpis.signal: Waymo (robotaxis) + Verily (sante) + autres moonshots. Optionnalite long terme.
kpis.description_fr: Revenus Waymo (robotaxis Phoenix/SF/LA/Austin) + Verily + autres moonshots. Toujours en perte operationnelle (-4.4 Mds$ FY24) mais optionnalite Waymo significative.
kpis.description_en: Waymo (robotaxis Phoenix/SF/LA/Austin) + Verily + other moonshots revenue. Still operating loss (-$4.4B FY24) but Waymo optionality material.

company_description: Alphabet Inc. offers various products and platforms in the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia-Pacific, Canada, and Latin America. It operates through Google Services, Google Cloud, and Other Bets segments. The Google Services segment provides products and services, including ads, Android, Chrome, devices, Gmail, Google Drive, Google Maps, Google Photos, Google Play, Search, and YouTube. It is also involved in the sale of apps and in-app purchases and digital content in Google Play and YouTube; and devices, as well as the provision of YouTube consumer subscription services, such as YouTube TV, YouTube Music and Premium, NFL Sunday Ticket, and Google One. The Google Cloud segment offers consumption-based fees and subscriptions for AI solutions, including AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini enterprise. It also provides cybersecurity, and data and analytics services; Google Workspace that include cloud-based communication and collaboration tools for enterprises, such as Calendar, Gmail, Docs, Drive, and Meet; and other enterprise services. The Other Bets segment sells transportation and internet services. Alphabet Inc. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California.
